# Disagreement Log — Gospel of Thomas, Saying 37

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** GTH 037
**Total Disagreements:** 3

---

## Disagreement 1 — "be revealed to us" vs. "show yourself to us"

**Verse:** v.1
**EMET/LOGOS:** "when will you be revealed to us"
**PNEUMA:** "when will you show yourself to us"
**Issue:** Coptic *ouōnh* (passive) = to be revealed. PNEUMA's active "show yourself" changes the agency.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Be revealed" retained — the revelation is not Jesus's initiative but an event that occurs under certain conditions (specified in the answer).

---

## Disagreement 2 — "trample on them" vs. "stomp on them"

**Verse:** v.2
**EMET/LOGOS:** "trample on them"
**PNEUMA:** "stomp on them"
**Issue:** *Pate* = to tread, trample; "trample" carries more ritual weight (cf. Ps 91:13; Isa 63:3). "Stomp" is casual/aggressive.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Trample" retained.

---

## Disagreement 3 — "you will not be afraid" vs. "you will have no fear"

**Verse:** v.3
**EMET/LOGOS:** "you will not be afraid"
**PNEUMA:** "you will have no fear"
**Issue:** Minor. Both are accurate. "Will not be afraid" is more active; "have no fear" is more static.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Will not be afraid" retained.

---
